name: 34235 · Sarasota, FL
findings: ZIP 34235 (Sarasota) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34235 (Sarasota) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34235 (Sarasota) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).
